reason: The operator's own S3-compatible endpoint (SHOUTORY_S3_ENDPOINT); no user names this host. Private ranges are the normal case, so the user-URL policy would refuse it.
The operator's own clamd scanner (SHOUTORY_CLAMAV_HOST and SHOUTORY_CLAMAV_PORT, validated at start-up); the upload scan hook opens the socket and no user names the host.
The operator's own SMTP relay (SHOUTORY_SMTP_URL); nodemailer opens the socket and no user names the host.
Sends spans to the operator's own collector (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, http or https checked, off when unset); no user names the host.
Asks the operator's resolver about the operator's own sender domain; opens no connection to an address a user names, and a long SPF answer exceeds the guard's TXT cap.
